selection.reason: Typed source-first creates Filippo Pavlovic; typed context-first preserves Pavlovic but loses qualifications and invents a Thanksgiving streak. Both regress from four to three clearly faithful packets. No follow-up or new-subject inference justified. Diagnostic interventions are not candidate quality scores.

causal_limit: Changing only coach-name content changes the speaker outcome for this fixed prompt and evidence. Neither counterfactual name is copied, so the results do not support a general always-copy-the-coach rule. Removing the record does not resolve valuation or source-ownership failures.
